description: Core knowledge about protecting systems, networks, applications, and data from unauthorized access, attacks, and misuse.

topics.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
knowledge: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, applications, and data from digital threats.
The main goals of cybersecurity are confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA triad).
Authentication verifies identity, authorization controls permissions, and accounting tracks activity.
Security requires prevention, detection, response, and recovery.

topics.name: Common Cyber Threats
knowledge: Malware is malicious software designed to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access.
Viruses attach themselves to files and spread when executed.
Trojans disguise themselves as legitimate software.
Ransomware locks or encrypts data and demands payment.
Phishing uses fake messages or websites to trick users into revealing information.
Social engineering attacks target human behavior instead of only technical weaknesses.

topics.name: Network Security
knowledge: Network security protects communication systems from unauthorized access and attacks.
Firewalls control network traffic based on security rules.
Encryption protects information while it is stored or transmitted.
VPNs create secure connections over untrusted networks.
Secure network design uses segmentation, monitoring, and access control.

topics.name: Application Security
knowledge: Application security protects software from vulnerabilities.
Secure coding practices reduce bugs and security weaknesses.
Input validation prevents unsafe data from affecting applications.
Authentication systems should protect user accounts with strong security methods.
Regular updates and patches fix known vulnerabilities.

topics.name: Data Protection
knowledge: Sensitive data should be protected using encryption and access controls.
Backups help recover information after failures or attacks.
The principle of least privilege gives users only the permissions they need.
Data privacy focuses on responsible collection, storage, and usage of information.

topics.name: Security Monitoring
knowledge: Logs provide information about system activity and possible threats.
Intrusion detection systems monitor suspicious behavior.
Security operations analyze alerts and respond to incidents.
Continuous monitoring improves visibility and defense.

topics.name: Ethical Security
knowledge: Security professionals test systems only with permission.
Responsible disclosure helps organizations fix vulnerabilities safely.
Cybersecurity should be used to protect people, systems, and information.
